What the numbers say

For the session of Thursday, November 12, 2026, the DappGo regime model reads the tracked universe (36 US-listed stocks and ETFs on DappGo's reviewed watchlist) as mixed. SPY is below its 50-day average and above its 200-day average; its 20-day trend is sideways and realised volatility is in the moderate band.

12 of 36 tickers (33%) are priced above their own 20-day moving average, and 20 of 34 (59%) above their 200-day average. That sits between the model's 30% and 55% breadth thresholds, so breadth alone decides nothing here. On the day 11 rose and 25 fell; the median move was −1.22%.

1 ticker has a 14-day RSI at or below 30 (NVDA), and 1 at or above 70 (COST). An RSI extreme records how one-sided recent trading has been. It is not, by itself, evidence that the move is about to reverse.
